title: Sigma schedules: where the steps go
hook: The scheduler chooses which noise levels the solver visits. Same model, same steps, different error.

verified.claim: The formulas are read from the scheduler functions.
The lab's lists agree with ComfyUI's stored lists to rounding, for the first values printed at 10 steps on karras.
At full denoise the first noise is scaled by sqrt(1 + sigma^2).
ModelSamplingFlux computes mu linearly in the token count.
nm_sigmas ran on a CPU; sd15_karras_rho passes validate_prompt.

unchecked: The statements about Karras et al.'s rho, about Esser et al.'s Figure 6, and about Sabour et al. were checked at the first audit and not re-read this time.
The lab's error table is for a one-dimensional toy, so the ranking does not carry over to pictures.
